name: masilia/ibexa-blocks
description: Front-office rendering of pages made of blocks for Ibexa DXP: a content model for templates, field renderers, themes that extend each other, and the pieces every theme shares

suggest.doctrine/doctrine-migrations-bundle: The migration of the newsletter table
suggest.gregwar/captcha-bundle: A captcha on the contact forms
suggest.masilia/editorial-toolbox: In-context editing: the page and its blocks are marked for it
suggest.masilia/ibexa-ai-craft: The assistant builds pages with the blocks of the theme and reads the conventions of this package
suggest.masilia/ibexa-sites: Sets the layout, name, email and address of each site from its registry, and registers the sites that masilia:blocks:site:create makes
suggest.symfony/form: Contact forms made from a matrix of questions
suggest.symfony/mailer: Contact forms, form submissions and the newsletter
suggest.symfony/mime: Emails of the contact forms and the newsletter
suggest.symfony/validator: Contact forms made from a matrix of questions
